overview.en: Porcellio obsoletus is a terrestrial isopod historically known mainly from the eastern Mediterranean.
overview.fr: Porcellio obsoletus est un isopode terrestre historiquement connu surtout dans l’est de la Méditerranée.

reproduction.en: The sources reviewed provide no species-specific reproductive details.

ecology.en: A 2026 study reported it for the first time from mainland Portugal and Spain; the fragmented range may reflect natural history or human transport.
